description: Evaluates whether the skill prevents code truncation and placeholder patterns

criteria.description: Must NOT output '// TODO', '// ...', '/* rest */', or similar placeholder comments
Must NOT truncate code with '...' or 'similar to above' or 'remaining code here'
Every function must have a complete implementation, no stubs
Must include all necessary imports, not assume they exist
For large components, must split into multiple files rather than truncating
Must NOT use ellipsis (...) to skip code sections

testPrompt: Build a complete WorkoutHistoryTimeline component in React with TypeScript and styled-components. It should fetch workout data from an API, display a scrollable list of workouts with expandable exercise details, support inline editing of reps/weight, and have loading/empty/error states.
